We conduct instruction tuning on MoCE using three distinct datasets. These include SlimOrca ... a curated version of the OpenOrca dataset comprising 518K multi-task examples; Magicoder , which contains 110K coding problems, providing a rich source for programming and algorithmic tasks; and MetaMathQA , consisting of 395K mathematical questions.
